title: Routines and Discipline
content: Piyush has established a routine of placing his phone outside the bedroom, specifically in a cupboard across the room, and refraining from using it for 30 minutes before sleep. He believes in the principle of 'small, keepable promises' and practices discipline by maintaining the gap between his promises to himself and his actual actions. Piyush has also utilized the app Habitica to manage his habits and daily tasks.
raw_text:
- Phone outside the bedroom at night (in the cupboard across the room) and no phone for 30 minutes before sleep
- Principle: small, keepable promises. Discipline = the gap between promises made and promises kept
- Has used Habitica for habits and dailies
